name: Garden of Divinity
source:
Step into The Garden, get a brief glance at its inhabitants, cough up an organ or two, and remember very little about your past.

[from [url=https://jumper-insectia.itch.io/garden-of-divinity-jv]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
走進花園，匆匆看一眼住在裡面的人，交出一兩個器官。至於自己的過去，你已經記不得多少了。

［摘自[url=https://jumper-insectia.itch.io/garden-of-divinity-jv]itch.io[/url]］
